providers._comment: Long-term memory is opt-in. Install kryten-llm[memory] and set enabled=true.

retrieval._query_mode_comment: query_mode 'window' pools the last window_size chat messages into the query vector so recall tracks the ongoing topic, not just the last line. window_recency_weight 0 = plain mean; >0 weights recent messages higher (geometric decay).
retrieval._pooling_comment: pooling_strategy for the window vector: 'mean', 'recency' (uses window_recency_weight), or 'attention' (weights messages by length/recency/centrality; drops those below min_salience).

providers._cross_user_comment: Sprint 8 associative recall. Master switch for any retrieval that can surface OTHER users' facts (topical/room/ambient). Requires a running kryten-moderator for the shadow-mute gate below. Default off.

moderation_gate._comment: Excludes currently-silenced users from cross-user recall via kryten-moderator's 'entry.list' command (kryten.moderator.command). fail_closed=true withholds cross-user recall if the moderator can't be reached.

topical._comment: Topic-scoped recall (Sortie 1): on the listed trigger types, surface facts similar to the current message regardless of author, attributed by name. Requires cross_user.enabled=true.

category_routing._comment: Present the speaker's facts as labeled sections by category (Sortie 4). mode 'sections' = one fragment with headed sections; 'fragments' = one fragment per category (independently budget-trimmable via the priority map). Disabled = flat list (default).

room_awareness._comment: Surface facts for OTHER people currently in the room (Sortie 2), derived from recent chatters. Requires cross_user.enabled=true; silenced users excluded.
room_awareness._presence_comment: presence_source 'userlist' reads the robot's authoritative userlist KV (who's actually in channel); 'recent_activity' uses recent chatters. Falls back to recent_activity if the userlist is unavailable.

novelty._comment: Read-only novelty/contradiction signal (Sortie 6): emits a 'memory_signal' fragment when the message is far from everything stored about the speaker (novel) or close-but-opposite (contradiction). Never stores facts. Speaker-scoped; no cross_user dependency.
novelty.contradiction_label: This may update what you knew
novelty._contradiction_comment: contradiction_method 'heuristic' = keyword-negation (Sprint 8); 'embedding' = opposition scoring vs. a negated form of the fact (Sprint 9), with a cold-start guard and heuristic fallback.

callback._comment: Occasionally resurface an old, important, off-topic fact (Sortie 6/5). scope 'speaker' needs no cross_user; scope 'any' resurfaces other users' old facts and requires cross_user.enabled + passes the shadow-mute gate. Probabilistic + cooldown-limited; never stores facts.
callback.label: You also remember

ambient._comment: Ambient mood recall (Sortie 7): maintains an EWMA 'mood vector' of recent chatter and, on auto_participation once warmed up, surfaces whole-room facts near that vibe. Requires cross_user.enabled=true; silenced users excluded; shadow-muted messages never shape the mood.

trace._comment: Sprint 9 observability: memory metrics are always exported via the metrics server (llm_memory_*). This optional per-turn debug trace logs which fragments were injected. include_content logs fact text too — privacy-sensitive, keep off except for short tuning windows.

store._comment: Default embedded Chroma. Embedded PersistentClient is SINGLE-PROCESS only; do not run the service and 'memory seed' against the same path at once (corrupts the index). For concurrency either add http_host/http_port to use a 'chroma run' server, or switch to the pgvector backend below.
store._http_comment: Optional Chroma client/server mode (concurrency-safe). Start `chroma run --path ./data/chroma --port 8000`, then set these on BOTH the service and the seed job. When http_host is set, 'path' is ignored.

_store_pgvector_example._comment: PostgreSQL + pgvector backend (concurrency-safe: live bot and multi-day 'memory seed' can share one DB). Install kryten-llm[pgvector] and use a DEDICATED database, not your CMS DB. See docs/pgvector-setup.md. To enable, rename this key to 'store'.
_store_pgvector_example._dsn_comment: Provide the connection in ONE of three ways (most-preferred first). dsn_env keeps the password out of config.
_store_pgvector_example._discrete_parts_comment: Or omit dsn_env/dsn and set these instead; password comes from password_env (preferred) or password.

extractor._comment: type 'heuristic' (default) needs no LLM. Set type 'llm' for the Phase 7f LLM-driven extractor; it uses a DEDICATED extractor.llm connection and NEVER falls back to llm_providers.
